headline: Student activity accounts, special education costs, budget transfers, and future meeting scheduling.
summary: The subcommittee will review student activity account items including GHS Theatre/Drama account creation and FY 26 balances. It will also cover special education topics such as FY27 Circuit Breaker Reimbursement, NEC Quarterly Update, out of district tuition and transportation, future meeting arrangements, and budget transfers.
location: Gloucester High School Library, 32 Leslie O. Johnson Road, Gloucester, MA 01930
